svg.title: Adrian Węcławski “Wulf” · Wulf Code it: Enter it once. The system does the rest.
svg.desc: Apps, automations and websites for businesses in Germany and Poland. Example from a real project: staff send two photos and a voice note on Telegram; the bot writes the caption, builds a reel, posts it to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok and updates the price on the website menu and on Glovo.
